summary: The commenter proposes 'Regulatory Condition Hash Binding': a technology-neutral cryptographic method that binds the regulatory conditions for a security position (KYC/AML status, sanctions screening, jurisdictional and issuer transfer restrictions) to its ownership-history record and links security-side and payment-side records for delivery-versus-payment settlement. The commenter says this could help transfer agents detect alteration and verify compliance evidence in DLT-based master securityholder files without putting personal data on-chain, while noting it does not by itself prove the underlying data or compliance determination was correct. This is the commenter's position, not an SEC or TitleChain Foundation conclusion.
